doc: FlexOlmo (AllenAI): OLMoE's softmax top-k MoE (per-expert tensors, norm_topk_prob) inside OLMo-2's block: post-norms only (post_attention_layernorm after the attention output, post_feedforward_layernorm after the MoE output) and the whole-projection q/k RMS norm. Third-party adapter (lane H): data only, extends the built-in olmoe and the post-norm mixin.
